evidence.why: Config shows the vendor API token expired on 2026-10-20

evidence.quote: 2026-10-20T02:00:06Z ERROR downloader [os-20261019] download failed: HTTP 401 Unauthorized from vendor; auth errors are not retried
evidence.why: Jobs started failing with HTTP 401 Unauthorized because the token expired

args.root_cause: The vendor API authentication token expired on 2026-10-20, causing subsequent order_sync job runs to fail with HTTP 401 Unauthorized errors and leaving the orders data stale.
args.suggested_fix: Renew the vendor API token in pipeline.yaml or the secrets manager so jobs can authenticate successfully.
